summary: Native Foundation verification has no trusted source-bound isolated preview producer; copied sandbox parent Git identity and a caller-provided preview cannot prove the actual public build
evidence: Existing canonical Foundation candidate test reproducibly returns local_evidence_missing without a bound private preview. Public910 native local-preview Host gate is correct; headers and transport are independently repaired. New producer must use the same release/import/build path with actual detached Git root, current source pin, checked dependency snapshot and bounded process lifecycle.
rollback: Revert only new producer and its fixed bridge call; preserve owned preview source/build/state and all evidence receipts. Existing candidate/retained checks and default transport remain intact. No old approval/source/report or original DB/runtime is rewritten.
